effect.u_message: The breathing exercises stop hurting and start humming.  You can feel it now: Qi, everywhere, pressing like weather.
Focus the jade slip (a) to meditate.  Eat before long sessions.  Do not cultivate in poisoned places.

//: Fruit on-ramp (design §5, §15.4, §15.6, §20.1). Power without control burns; power with control still stains. Grants TO CAP (design §15.4): the +300 is clamped to the realm soft-cap immediately (Mortal 50 ... Soul 10000) so the number never reads out of range. Also grants a progression head-start (cult_xp_generic): +100 unsensed / +200 sensed. This skips no gate — the first breakthrough is Qi-gated (50 + manual), so the XP carries into the Qi-Cond -> Foundation gate (500). The heat burn is followed by an explicit onfire clear: the engine rolls ignition on heat damage (src/creature.cpp), and a tutorial fruit must scorch, not immolate.
